turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a call at 4:40. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and was anyone going to speak to me before it went in the gradebook?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Version history of what, Hale? You haven't told me what document you're talking about, or what it shows. And I'll say it again: who decided on the zero, and was it before anyone spoke to Owen?
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing down 11:52 and 11:58. What date is that, whose document is it, and where does it come from? Turn the screen so I can read it myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and a written account of who decided on it and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written account of how the decision was made.
What moved her: Nothing, because the times and word counts were specific but came with no date, no named document, and no way for her to check them herself.
What cost ground: You never answered who decided on the zero or whether anyone spoke to Owen first, so she kept returning to the process instead of the evidence.
Try next time: Open by owning in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then turn the screen and show the version history with its date and both sets of times.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
